King Solomon wrote of the proper time for everything under the sun: a time to sow and a time to reap, a time to live and a time to die—and so on. No one will decide to lose fat (or stop being an alcoholic) until the proper time is reached—for him or her. No use being a zealot. A couple of teaspoons of sugar on your morning oatmeal or cereal, and beans or greens cooked in a small amount of bacon or ham won’t wreck your routine. Eat just about anything you want or crave (reasonable amounts) for one meal a week. Life without pizza on the weekend would be unendurable for some people. One alcoholic beverage (a beer, glass of wine, or a drink) once a week at mealtime is fine. Any eating plan will fail if it is too rigid.
